Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can digivolve into such a card.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to trash cards from my hand, can I then use this effect to digivolve into one of those cards from the trash?

Effect: [When Attacking] Trash 2 cards in your hand. Then, this Digimon may digivolve into a [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] trait Digimon card in the trash with the digivolution cost reduced by 2.
